notes.title: The Stone Cutter and the Mountain Spirit at BIG Festival
notes.content:
Hey guys!

From 29th of June until 2nd of July, the BIG Festival will take place in São Paulo and the Philosophical School of Games will be participating!

The Stone Cutter and the Mountain Spirit was selected for the Panorama Brasil show, which brings together some of the best games created by Brazilian companies in the last year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065200/The_Stone_Cutter_and_the_Mountain_Spirit/

If you are from São Paulo or are going to BIG, stop by the Philogames stand and let's talk!

I'll see you there!

notes.title: Huni Kuin on Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey guys!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1064250/Huni_Kuin_Beya_Xin_Bena/

Steam Next Fest is coming and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1064250/Huni_Kuin_Beya_Xin_Bena/]Huni Kuin[/url] will be participating with a fresh new demo, with several improvements in scenarios, bug fixes and general polishes!

Get to know a little more about the Huni Kuin people and their stories! The game is the result of a partnership between the Philosophical School of Games, Bobware and the indigenous collective Beya Xinã Bena! The full game will have 7 different stories and is expected to be released in mid-2024.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41819538/368dc69179c75285f1792e54bc21d5cd752b4d24.jpg[/img]

Leave your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1064250/discussions/]discussion forum[/url] and add the game on your Wishlist now!

Haux Haux!

notes.title: The Stone Cutter and the Mountain Spirit
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After 5 months of hard work, my next game is almost ready, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065200/The_Stone_Cutter_and_the_Mountain_Spirit/]The Stone Cutter and the Mountain Spirit[/url]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41819538/1734fd0412efbc9ade0d5118a0ca1dc8a6d65992.png[/img]

It's an interactive Fairy Tale about a poor stone cutter who gets tired of his simple life, then the Mountain Spirit appears and make his wishes com true!

A lot of achievements, puzzles and beautiful scenes to explore in this easy pace fairy tale about Will and Transformations in our lives. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41819538/bbfe379b9f2ab36f64fb45ca5700584749847090.png[/img]

The game will be release next month! For now, you guys can add to wishlist and prepare for a great experience!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41819538/71235827ff4fda7e763a70fd555a9c65fa1c9935.png[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Wings Update is out!
notes.content:
Hi folks!
We are happy to announce our latest update for A Butterfly's Dream! The Wings Update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41925463/957832c7984a51ba0cd52091341e385e0e02ee51.png[/img]

Not only more than 50 collectable Wing texture skins was added to the game map, but also a lot of improvements were made! Here is the complete list of changes!

[b]- Over 50 collectible wings scattered across the map![/b]
It's ease to find then: just follow the Light! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41925463/d3303b0e5bfbb3cb9661c692edc1b23e6b6fc8d8.png[/img]

[b]- Camera Controls completely reworked![/b]
No more fights against the camera! It's stable and now have a new Zoom In-Out function!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41925463/a40783f7935cb9b553a980b69292caaf1e376ce5.png[/img]

[b]- New musics![/b] 
More than 30 minutes of new content was added! Now the game has over a hour of a non-stop calm and relaxing music.

[b]- New Achievements/adjustments![/b] 
4 new achievements was added! Also it's much easier to get then now! you only need 5 photos of each animal! No more hours of boring and repetitive gameplay trying to find those damn snails! Also, now you can see those damn snails from a far distance than before!

[b]- New Menu Options[/b] 
To adjust camera sensitivity and a reset button to erase local saved games.

[b]- A lot of fixes, adjustments and improvements![/b]

That's all guys! We hope you enjoy this Update! Thanks for supporting the game!
Bugs or suggestions, check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1880640/discussions/]Forum[/url]!

notes.title: A Butterfly's Dream - Wings Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We were working on a new game that just got released ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1991450/Philosophical_Jigsaw__The_Zen_Koans/]check it out[/url]) and now it`s time to work on a big Update for A Butterfly's Dream! 

We will now have more than 50 butterflies skin variations! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41925463/02e4fd5e30b42744f790cb098788aaa9241f5b1e.png[/img]

- More than 50 butterfly skins!
- More songs!
- New objects to compose the map
- New settings to adjust camera controls
- and a lot of small improvements and adjustments

[b]The update will be released by the [u]end of June[/u], so stay tuned![/b]

ps: We are aware that the butterfly movement is not perfect and some people want more stable controllers, unfortunately this will not be included in the current update because it will need a complete rework on the current animal controller system and that will take too much time! When the studio grows up a little more we will definitely make this fix!
